message: Hi John, I hope you're doing well. I was wondering if you could provide me with Timothy's class schedule? I want to be more involved in his school life. Thanks
Reminder: Grade 7 science project submissions are due by Friday.
Parent-Teacher conferences are scheduled for March 5th. We look forward to seeing you there.

Hey, are we still on for the math study group tomorrow? Btw, here is my schedule. Is there any class we can go together?
Here's his schedule: Monday - Math in Room 101 at 9:00 AM, Science in Lab 204 at 10:30 AM; Tuesday - English in Room 102 at 9:00 AM, History in Room 201 at 10:30 AM; Wednesday - Art in Studio 5 at 9:00 AM, Physical Education in the Gym at 10:30 AM; Thursday - Music in Room 301 at 9:00 AM, Geography in Room 202 at 10:30 AM; Friday - Drama in Theater 2 at 9:00 AM, Computer Science in Lab 305 at 10:30 AM.
Track and field practice will be held in the gym today due to the weather.
John, I've been trying to get in touch with Timothy's teachers, but I haven't had much luck. Can you help?
Don't forget the PTA meeting next Thursday at 7 PM. We'll be discussing new after-school programs.
The library will be hosting a book fair next week. Volunteers needed!
A reminder that my office is always open for students who need someone to talk to.
Is there a calendar of school events that I could have? I want to make sure I'm up to date with what's happening at Oakwood.
